prompt: I need to migrate our aipcc-claudio repo from GitLab to GitHub. It has a real CI pipeline that builds and pushes a container image. Can you help me get started?

assertions.text: Creates a migration-manifest.yaml with repo set to aipcc-claudio
Manifest has source_gitlab path containing aipcc-claudio
Phase 0 assessment table is presented showing CI, container push, GitHub state, etc.
No phases are skipped (has_ci and has_container_push are both true)
Branch classification is shown with keep/delete/ask categories
Proceeds to Phase 1 cleanup guidance after Phase 0
